defects.label: blocker
defects.summary: Governance tool policy for the Review stage forbids any artifact/workspace writes, but reviewers are required to emit findings-only artifacts (e.g., review_findings.json). This makes the Review stage impossible to execute as specified.

evidence.note: Review stage allowlisted_tools excludes artifact_write.
Review stage restrictions deny artifact_write and workspace_write.
evidence.quote: {"network":"deny","repo_write":"deny","artifact_write":"deny","workspace_write":"deny","notes":"Reviewers are findings-only; they do not emit canonical writing/patch artifacts."}

evidence.note: R22 requires reviewers to produce findings-only artifacts.
evidence.quote: "reviewers produce findings-only artifacts (no writing or patches)"

evidence.note: O2 Per-Lane Reviewer responsibilities require producing review_findings.json.
evidence.quote: "Produce per-lane review_findings.json with RFC 6901 evidence pointers; flag cross-lane dependency issues."

patch.description: Update Review stage tool_policy to allow artifact_write for findings-only outputs (e.g., review_findings.json) while continuing to forbid patch/code writes. Concretely: add "artifact_write" to Review stage allowlisted_tools, and replace restrictions artifact_write:"deny" with a constrained allowance such as "canonical_allowed_only_for_review_findings" (or equivalent existing enum/value in the governing schema).

defects.label: blocker
defects.summary: Intake stage tool policy omits artifact_write, but Intake is required to initialize the canonical audit spine (implementation_run_manifest.json, implementation_event_log.jsonl) and emit a stage_handoff at the Intake boundary. This blocks run initialization as specified.

evidence.note: Intake stage allowlisted_tools omits artifact_write.
R8 requires run_manifest/event_log as audit spine outputs.
evidence.quote: "The audit spine SHALL include an implementation_run_manifest that is immutable once created and an implementation_event_log that is append-only"

evidence.note: R5 requires a stage_handoff artifact at each stage transition (including after Intake).
evidence.quote: "At every checkpoint boundary (i.e., each stage transition), the system SHALL emit a stage_handoff"

evidence.note: M1 requires initializing audit spine + Intake→Parallel stage_handoff.
evidence.quote: "Initialized audit spine artifacts... with an Intake→Parallel stage_handoff emitted."

patch.description: Update Intake stage tool_policy to allow writing the canonical audit spine artifacts and the Intake→* stage_handoff. Concretely: add "artifact_write" (and any required workspace write capability if stage_handoff is stored in workspace) to allowlisted_tools, and relax restrictions from artifact_write/workspace_write "allow_noncanonical_only" to a constrained canonical allowance for run_manifest/event_log/stage_handoff only.

defects.label: blocker
defects.summary: Evidence pointer objects violate the plan’s own declared evidence-pointer structure {artifact_ref, entity_id|null, json_pointer, note}. Current evidence entries omit entity_id and add extra fields (candidate_id, artifact_id, quote), causing internal schema/standard mismatch and likely validator failure for trace/evidence linting.

evidence.note: R10 mandates evidence pointers use {artifact_ref, entity_id|null, json_pointer, note}.
evidence.quote: "RFC 6901 JSON Pointer objects with the structure {artifact_ref, entity_id|null, json_pointer, note}"

evidence.note: Decision_log evidence pointer includes extra fields and omits entity_id.
Synthesis_warnings evidence pointer includes extra fields and omits entity_id.

patch.description: Normalize all evidence pointer objects to exactly {artifact_ref, entity_id, json_pointer, note} (entity_id explicitly present with null when not applicable). Remove non-standard fields (candidate_id, artifact_id, quote) or relocate them to non-canonical commentary fields if needed. Apply at minimum to /plan_package/decision_log/*/evidence_pointers/* and /plan_package/synthesis_warnings/*/evidence/*.

Fix requires renaming existing deliverable IDs, but the required canonical format is not specified in the candidate; recommend reroute to the plan synthesizer/ID-policy owner.

evidence.note: Example deliverable id format currently used.
Additional example showing same pattern across milestones.

patch.description: Deliverable ID format policy (DL#) is external/implicit; update requires coordinated renames across milestones and any references. Reroute to synthesizer/ID-policy owner to apply consistent ID normalization.

defects.label: blocker
defects.summary: Architecture option risks are flagged as referencing missing risks (strings in options.*.risks do not correspond to registered risks per id-integrity rules). Fix likely requires mapping option-level risk statements to existing risk_register IDs or adding new K# entries, which is ID-bearing and should be rerouted.

Option O2 risks similarly not mapped to risk_register IDs.
Existing registered risks (K#) that option risks may need to reference.

patch.description: If id_integrity requires option risks to be references to risk_register entries, either (a) rewrite option risks to reference existing K# IDs, or (b) add missing risks as new K# entries. Both are ID-governed changes; reroute to synthesizer/requirements owner.

DEC1–DEC5 exist and can be referenced.

defects.label: fix
defects.summary: Workflow stage naming is inconsistent across requirements, tool_policy, architecture, and milestones (e.g., R4 names Intake/Generate/Validate/Review/Judge/Freeze while tool_policy includes WorkPlanning/PatchApply/IntegrateAndValidate and milestones reference Intake→Parallel and an Integration sub-flow). This can break any validator keyed to exact stage identifiers for checkpoint/stage_handoff enforcement.

evidence.note: R4 lists minimum stages (does not mention WorkPlanning/PatchApply/IntegrateAndValidate).
evidence.quote: "at minimum the stages: Intake → Generate → Validate → Review → Judge → Freeze"

evidence.note: tool_policy uses additional/different stage identifiers.
Milestones reference fan-out naming (Intake→Parallel).
Milestone M4 names a multi-step integration sub-flow (merge/validate/review/patch).

patch.description: Define a single canonical set of stage identifiers (or an alias map) and reference it consistently. Minimal edit: update R4 to acknowledge additional orchestrator sub-stages (e.g., WorkPlanning, PatchApply, IntegrateAndValidate) while keeping the minimum set, and state that stage_handoff is required for every transition among the canonical identifiers used by tool_policy.
